matches.rationale: The ground truth defect is located in Lemma 1 and concerns incorrect equations/logical steps there (propagating to Proposition 2 and the main theorem). All four findings instead target distinct, explicitly identified content in Lemma 2 (eigenvalue formulas ζ1–ζ4, cosθ substitutions, the a0 expression) and Lemma 3 (the set D1's radius), none of which correspond to Lemma 1's content or its downstream effect on Proposition 2/main theorem. These are different loci and different claims, not a mere relabeling of the same material.
